acceptance_criteria.text: config.agent.schema.json is a complete schema for the current persistent local agent-config surface.
proof: common/tests/test_agent_config_schema.py covers mail, calendar, contacts, directory, forms, oauth_apps.catalog, accounts omission, and descriptions
